	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = administrative_palace_1
			aub_can_upgrade_to_administrative_palace_2_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_2 }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = administrative_palace_1
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = administrative_palace_2 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = administrative_palace_2
			aub_can_upgrade_to_administrative_palace_3_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_3 }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = administrative_palace_2
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = administrative_palace_3 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = administrative_palace_3
			aub_can_upgrade_to_administrative_palace_4_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_4 }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = administrative_palace_3
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = administrative_palace_4 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = administrative_palace_4
			aub_can_upgrade_to_administrative_palace_5_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = royal_building_cost_tier_5 }
